task_completion.description: Open the Docker Desktop Settings/Preferences window.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Docker Desktop application window is visible, specifically showing the 'Settings' or 'Preferences' interface (often indicated by a gear icon).

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Docker Engine' tab within the settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Docker Engine' tab is selected in the sidebar, and a JSON configuration editor is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Add or modify the 'bip' key in the Docker Engine JSON configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text editor in the Docker Engine tab shows the key '"bip":' being typed or present within the JSON object.
The JSON configuration explicitly contains the line: "bip": "192.168.200.1/24".

task_completion.description: Click the 'Apply & Restart' button to save the changes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Apply & Restart' button is clicked, or a progress bar/loading state appears indicating the Docker daemon is restarting with the new configuration.

integrity.description: The agent used the Docker Desktop GUI rather than just executing terminal commands to bypass the interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Docker Desktop settings window and the JSON editor.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Docker Desktop application, not a simulated text file or mock UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window decorations, system tray icons, and Docker logo confirm the authentic Docker Desktop environment.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or pasted the configuration into the engine settings rather than just displaying a success message.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'bip' configuration is visible within the Docker Engine text area before the 'Apply' button is pressed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires setting the 'bip' (Bridge IP) property in the Docker Engine JSON configuration. The exact required value is '192.168.200.1/24'. Setting this value automatically configures the default bridge network to the subnet '192.168.200.0/24' with a gateway of '192.168.200.1'. The VLM should verify the presence of the 'bip' key and the specific IP/CIDR string in the Docker Desktop settings editor.
